buy_hold.note: Buy on first bar, hold to the end. Every candidate must beat this on risk-adjusted terms.

tsmom_ema_filter.source: TSMOM with long-term EMA regime filter
tsmom_ema_filter.note: Daily TSMOM, but only long while close is above a long EMA (regime filter); exit when momentum turns negative or close drops below the EMA.

tsmom_30d.note: Long when the trailing N-day return is positive, evaluated once a day at 00:00 UTC; exit when negative. Wide disaster stop only.

ema_cross_trend.note: EMA fast>slow cross while close>EMA trend; exit on cross down; ATR trailing stop.

random_entry_atr_exits.note: Random entries (~2% of bars) with the Donchian strategy's ATR stop/TP. If a strategy barely beats this, its edge is the exit logic or luck.

pine_ultimate_long.note: SMA9>SMA21 & close>SMA200 & 40<RSI<80 & MACD>signal & hist rising & stoch K>D, 20<K<80 & higher-high & higher-low vs prior 10 bars & volume>1.2xSMA20 & ATR/close<3% & previous completed daily close > daily SMA50 -> enter 10% equity; stop -3% / take-profit +6% from fill. The script's 'reversal exit' can never trigger (RSI>70 while below SMA200) and is omitted.

tr3_long.source: Krishhiv/HMM_TR_Alg TR3 engine, no regime gate
tr3_long.note: EMA50>EMA200 & close>EMA50 & (close>prior 20-bar high OR 1-bar thrust >= 0.75 ATR) & CLV>=0.55 & ADX14>=14 & R2(EMA50,72)>=0.10 -> enter next open; exits: fail-to-hold (CLV<=0.35 or close<entry-bar high-0.25ATR while <0.5ATR up), delayed breakeven after 0.75-1.0 ATR advance, ratcheting 2.5/3.5/4.5-ATR trail, EMA50 break (0.25ATR cushion once >=1 ATR up), 12h no-progress, 7-day time stop. Sizing 1.0x (the original's 1.3x equity-curve throttle is leverage and is removed). No HMM gate (isolates the engine).

pairs_longleg.note: Spread = log(asset) - beta*log(partner) with rolling OLS beta over `window` bars; z = (spread-mean)/std over the same window. Long the asset when z < -z_entry (cheap vs partner); exit when z > -z_exit or 8% stop. Partner = the other major with the highest rolling correlation (BTC/ETH/SOL only). Original is long/short cointegration baskets on 18 Binance.US alts with no stop; its claims do not apply.
